scheduled_files.csr_access.fsm:
(?fsm:csr_access

  (+system
    (clock clk)
    (areset rst_n)
  )

  (+interface
    (input start)
    (input wdata)
    (output done)
    (output status_out)
    (output control_out)
    (internal status)
    (internal control)
  )

  (+size
    (start 1)
    (wdata 8)
    (done 1)
    (status_out 8)
    (control_out 8)
    (status 8 (reset 0))
    (control 8 (reset 0))
    (can_accept 1)
  )

  (main_idle_0
    (= (can_accept 1))
    (<start
      (-> main_set_1)
    )
  )

  (main_set_1
    (<- (control wdata))
    (-> main_update_2)
  )

  (main_update_2
    (<- (status_out> status))
    (-> main_update_3)
  )

  (main_update_3
    (<- (control_out> control))
    (-> main_done_4)
  )

  (main_done_4
    (<1 (done> 1))
    (-> main_idle_0)
  )

)
